# Surge beta module

Install this module in Surge:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ahuai6/Sub-Store-Fork/main/dist/Surge-Beta.sgmodule
```

The same file is attached to each GitHub Release:

```
https://github.com/ahuai6/Sub-Store-Fork/releases/latest/download/Surge-Beta.sgmodule
```

Script paths inside the module use `releases/latest/download` on this repository. `config/Surge-Beta.sgmodule` stays identical to upstream. This file is the rendered copy: artifact host, CORS origin `https://ahuai6.github.io`, file routes on Core, and sync / produce / prefetch default off.

`scripts/check/geo.js` is the Script Operator source:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ahuai6/Sub-Store-Fork/main/scripts/check/geo.js
```

Its GPL-3.0 text is `scripts/check/GEO-LICENSE.txt`. Attribution is `scripts/check/GEO-NOTICE.md`. The backend license is the repository root `LICENSE` (AGPL-3.0). Each Release also attaches `geo.js`, `GEO-LICENSE.txt`, and `GEO-NOTICE.md`.

Frontend: https://ahuai6.github.io/Sub-Store-Fork/
